chars.WIFE: WIFE: a Moroccan woman about 30, wearing a mustard-yellow hijab, a long olive-green trench coat, light jeans and white sneakers
chars.COLLEAGUE: COLLEAGUE: a Moroccan man about 31, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a burgundy bomber jacket over a grey t-shirt and black jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the bottom of a narrow apartment stairwell in Casablanca, WIFE climbing the stairs quickly, glancing back over her shoulder nervously, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, evening light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the stairs landing, COLLEAGUE opens his apartment door and WIFE slips inside smiling, both faces visible, warm light from the doorway

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: COLLEAGUE in his small rented studio apartment in Casablanca, pouring two coffees in a tiny kitchen corner, smug smile, medium shot

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: WIFE sitting on a grey sofa in the studio, talking and gesturing in frustration, COLLEAGUE sitting next to her listening and nodding, coffee cups on a small table

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: COLLEAGUE packing clothes into an open suitcase on the bed, WIFE standing by the door shocked with her hand on her chest

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: WIFE arguing angrily with COLLEAGUE in the studio, pointing at him, he raises his hands defensively, tense

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: COLLEAGUE alone on the small balcony at night, smiling while on a video call on his phone, looking over his shoulder secretly

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: WIFE threatening COLLEAGUE, holding up her phone toward him, he looks shocked and worried, studio apartment

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: COLLEAGUE secretly holding a woman's phone with a yellow case in one hand and his own phone in the other, copying a number, sly expression, dim room
